description: A 4th CE boundary wall running between Fiernhay Street and St Nicholas Priory discovered during excavations. Holbrook has suggested that this could be the boundary of a temenos, the precinct of an urban temple. It is likely that a temple, like most Roman cities in Britain, would have included a temple and temenos somewhere. But only further excavation can confirm if this wall is the boundary of one, we cannot confirm the exact location of the proposed temple or its dating beyond the 4th CE.
